battle.name: 美國入侵巴拿馬
battle.brief: 1989年12月20日凌晨零時四十六分，美軍在巴拿馬城、運河區與阿馬多爾堡同時動手，當夜端掉國防軍指揮部，五日內瓦解巴拿馬國防軍。空降兵封死泛美公路，AH-64阿帕奇與AH-1W在喬里略街巷以六管機炮掃射。卡面加特林機槍未參戰，其血統正是這些速射機關。

kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries:
這場衝突在形式上是美國與巴拿馬兩個國家之間的戰爭，實際上卻是美國單方面對巴拿馬國防軍的作戰，沒有前線談判，也沒有戰俘交換。美國一方由總統喬治·H·W·布希拍板：他在1989年12月17日簽署命令，啟動代號「正義事業」的行動，12月20日開火後當日上午再向全國宣布四項理由——保護在巴拿馬的三萬五千名美國公民、維護巴拿馬的民主與人權、打擊毒品洗錢與販運、維護《巴拿馬運河條約》的執行。軍令系統上，參謀長聯席會議主席科林·鮑威爾在巴拿馬前線協調全局，南方司令部司令喬治·克里斯特中將指揮南方聯合特遣部隊，第82空降師承擔巴拿馬城方向的地面作戰，第508空降步兵團與海軍海豹突擊隊分別負責堡壘與要點的奇襲，第一支特種作戰分遣隊接手對諾列加本人的捕獲任務。作戰目標由「90-2計畫」列成六條：保護美國公民與關鍵場所設施、擒獲諾列加移交司法機構、瓦解巴拿馬國防軍、摧毀其指揮系統、支持美方承認的恩達拉政府、重組國防軍。
巴拿馬一方並無對等的國家指揮體系。曼努埃爾·諾列加以國防軍最高首長的身分直接控制國家：1978年軍事政變後逐步清洗軍界，1984年迫使當選總統羅約去職，1985年解散國民大會，1989年1月阻止副總統馬斯尼宣誓就任，國防軍從此只對他一人負責。軍隊規模約一萬六千人，絕大部分集中在巴拿馬城，其餘各營分散在科倫、戴維與聖米格爾等省區；空軍只有數架老舊攻擊機與螺旋槳運輸機，海軍僅有幾艘巡邏艇與內河汽艇，沒有任何能與美國海軍對抗的水面艦艇。諾列加把巴拿馬變成自己最後的堡壘，12月20日當夜，他的指揮系統在四個小時內被連根拔起。
countriesEn: In form this was a war between the two states of the United States and Panama, but in practice it was a unilateral American campaign against the Panamanian Defence Force, with no front-line negotiation and no exchange of prisoners. On the American side the decision was taken by President George H. W. Bush, who signed the order launching Operation Just Cause on 17 December 1989 and, on the morning of 20 December once the fighting had begun, addressed the nation with four reasons: protecting the thirty-five thousand American citizens in Panama, defending Panamanian democracy and human rights, cutting the drug money and the drug trade, and enforcing the Panama Canal Treaty. The chain of command ran from the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Colin Powell, who coordinated the campaign on the ground in Panama, through General George Crist, commander in chief of the United States Southern Command, who commanded the Southern Joint Task Force; the 82nd Airborne Division carried the ground effort in the direction of Panama City; the 508th Parachute Infantry Regiment and the Navy SEALs were given the assault on the fortification and on the strongpoints; and the first Special Forces operational detachment took over the task of capturing Noriega himself. The operational objectives were set out in the 90-2 plan: protect American lives and critical installations, capture Noriega and hand him over to the judicial authorities, break up the Panamanian Defence Force, destroy its command system, support the Panamanian government recognised by Washington, and reorganise the Defence Force. On the Panamanian side there was no equivalent state command structure. Manuel Noriega controlled the country directly as the senior commander of the Defence Force: after the military coup of 1978 he purged the officer corps step by step, in 1984 he forced the elected president Royo out of office, in 1985 he dissolved the National Assembly, and in January 1989 he prevented the vice president Masni from taking his oath, so that from that moment the Defence Force answered to him alone. The force numbered about sixteen thousand men, the great majority of them in Panama City, with separate battalions dispersed across the provinces of Colón, David and San Miguel. The air force had only a handful of ageing attack aircraft and piston transports, the navy only patrol boats and river craft, and no surface vessel capable of standing against the American fleet. Noriega turned Panama into his own redoubt, and on the night of 20 December his command system was torn out at its roots within four hours.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物橫跨政界與軍界。美國方面，總統布希是決策者，也是對外發言人；參謀長聯席會議主席科林·鮑威爾偏好「正義事業」這個名稱，理由是即便最嚴厲的批評者在譴責美軍時也不得不說出「正義事業」四字；南方司令部司令喬治·克里斯特中將負責戰區指揮。巴拿馬方面，實際統治者曼努埃爾·諾列加自1967年起就是美國中央情報局在巴拿馬的線人，八十年代仍在按年領取情報報酬，是美國情報界的老合作夥伴，也是美國在對抗尼加拉瓜桑地諾陣線時期在巴拿馬的倚重；1988年2月他因毒品指控被聯邦大陪審團起訴，同年11月在聯合國投票支持桑地諾陣線後與美方公開決裂。巴拿馬反對派領袖吉列爾莫·恩達拉是1989年5月大選中以近三比一領先的候選人，選舉被作廢後，他於1989年9月1日在美國使館宣誓組成流亡政府；12月20日開火數小時後，他在克萊頓堡軍事基地宣誓就任總統，副手法比安·阿里斯蒂德斯隨後出任副總統。前副總統莫伊塞斯·馬斯尼的宣誓被諾列加阻擋；1989年10月失敗的政變由國防軍少校莫伊塞斯·希羅爾迪等人策動，事後主謀者被處決。戰場上的個人事蹟同樣密集：12月15日夜四名美軍軍人在喬里略區路障前被攔下，軍方說他們未帶武器、乘私家車外出，國防軍則稱他們在執行偵察，槍火中海軍陸戰隊中尉羅伯特·帕茲背部中彈，兩天後因傷重死亡，同行的海豹突擊隊中尉亞當·柯蒂斯與其妻邦妮被扣押毆打。另一端，喬治亞州本寧堡第988憲兵連上尉琳達·L·布雷率部與國防軍交火三小時，媒體稱她是第一位指揮美軍作戰的女性；中尉莉莎·庫切拉與准尉黛布拉·曼駕駛UH-60黑鷹直升機運送步兵時遭地面火力攻擊。
peopleEn: The key figures whose names survive stretch across politics and the armed services. On the American side President Bush was both the decision maker and the spokesman to the country; the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Colin Powell, preferred the name Just Cause on the ground that even the harshest critics, when condemning the American action, would be obliged to utter the words Just Cause; and General George Crist, commander in chief of Southern Command, ran the theatre. On the Panamanian side Manuel Noriega, the real ruler, had been a CIA asset in Panama from 1967 and was still drawing his retainer in the 1980s; he was a long-standing partner of American intelligence and the man Washington relied on in Panama during the fight against the Nicaraguan Sandinista movement. In February 1988 he was indicted by a federal grand jury on drug charges, and in November of the same year he voted in the United Nations with the Sandinistas, after which the break with Washington became public. The leader of the Panamanian opposition, Guillermo Endara, was the candidate who led by nearly three to one in the May 1989 election; after that election was annulled he took the oath to form a government in exile at the American embassy on 1 September 1989, and a few hours after the fighting began on 20 December he was sworn in as president at Fort Clayton, with Fabián Aristides as vice president. The oath of the former vice president Moisés Masni had been blocked by Noriega, and the failed coup of October 1989 was plotted by such men as major Moisés Giroldi of the Defence Force, the principals being executed afterwards. The personal episodes of the fighting are equally dense: on the night of 15 December four American servicemen were stopped at a roadblock in the Chorrillo district, the military saying they were unarmed and out in a private car, while the Defence Force said they were on reconnaissance; in the gunfire Marine Lieutenant Robert Paz was shot in the back and died of his wounds two days later, while Navy SEAL Lieutenant Adam Curtis and his wife Bonnie were detained and beaten. On the other side, Captain Linda L. Bray of the 988th Military Police Company at Fort Benning, Georgia, fought the Defence Force for three hours and was described by the media as the first woman to command American troops in combat; and Lieutenants Lisa Kutchera and Debra Mann flew UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters under ground fire while ferrying infantry.

卡面這件兵器本身並未出現在巴拿馬。加特林機槍是1860年理查德·喬登·加特林發明的六管手搖速射機關，1862年為美國海軍採用，是旋轉機炮的祖型；但到1989年，這一條血統早已改寫成電力驅動的鋼製機關：AH-1W超級眼鏡蛇、AH-64A阿帕奇、UH-60黑鷹與OH-58D武裝直升機上的是M134迷你砲，7.62毫米口徑、六管、每分鐘三千發；美國海軍陸戰隊的AV-8B牛式攻擊機上裝的是M61A1火神砲，20毫米口徑、同樣六管、每分鐘六千發；AC-130「幽靈」砲艇與A-10戰機上的是GAU-8系列轉管砲，海軍的密集陣系統也是同一構型。1989年12月20日之後，巴拿馬城街巷裡真正壓制國防軍火力點的，就是這些六管旋轉機炮：阿帕奇在這場戰爭中第一次實戰，與AH-1W一起在屋頂與窗口對街壘射擊。
其他裝備同樣值得記錄。美軍投入的空運包括第317與第314戰術空運聯隊的C-130大力神（部分加裝AWADS惡劣天氣空投系統）、C-141星式與C-5銀河；電子戰由第366戰術戰鬥機聯隊390電子戰中隊的兩架EF-111A渡鴉式對巴拿馬雷達實施干擾；武裝直升機以AH-64阿帕奇為主，另有AH-1W與UH-60護送。最特別的是第508空降步兵團第1營C連與第82空降師第3營C連裝備的M551謝里登輕型坦克：四輛於1989年11月由C-5秘密運抵霍華德空軍基地，另有十輛在開戰後數小時內由C-141空投到托庫門國際機場，這是該型坦克唯一一次作戰空投。地面部隊還首次大量使用悍馬高機動車。
巴拿馬國防軍的裝備則是老式蘇系與中系混裝：AK-47與AKM步槍、RPG-7火箭筒、通用機槍與小口徑高射炮，另有美國在八十年代援助的M16步槍與M2機槍。空軍只有數架A-37「蜻蜓」攻擊機與雙發螺旋槳運輸機，海軍只有巡邏艇與內河汽艇，一艘巡邏艇在首夜被海豹突擊隊擊沉。兩相比較，差距不在單件兵器，而在制空權、運輸能力與夜視器材的整體差距。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card did not itself appear in Panama. The Gatling gun was the six-barreled hand-cranked repeating weapon invented by Richard Jordan Gatling in 1860 and taken up by the United States Navy in 1862; it is the ancestor of the rotary cannon. But by 1989 that line of descent had been rewritten into electric-driven steel: the AH-1W Super Cobra, the AH-64A Apache, the UH-60 Black Hawk and the OH-58D carry the M134 minigun, 7.62mm calibre, six barrels, three thousand rounds a minute; the United States Marine Corps AV-8B Harrier carries the M61A1 Vulcan, 20mm calibre, likewise six barrels, six thousand rounds a minute; the AC-130 Spectre gunship and the A-10 carry the GAU-8 series of rotary cannons, and the naval close-in weapon system is the same configuration. After 20 December 1989 it was these six-barreled rotary guns that actually pinned the fire points of the Defence Force in the streets of Panama City: the Apache fought its first combat here, working with the AH-1W from rooftops and windows against the barricades. The rest of the equipment is equally worth recording. The American airlift included C-130 Hercules transports of the 317th and 314th Tactical Air Transport Wings, some fitted with the adverse weather aerial delivery system, together with C-141 Starlifters and C-5 Galaxies; the electronic war was fought by two EF-111A Ravens of the 390th Electronic Combat Squadron, 366th Tactical Fighter Wing, which jammed the Panamanian radar network; and the armed helicopters were led by the AH-64 Apache, with the AH-1W and UH-60 in support. The most remarkable single item was the M551 Sheridan light tank of Company C, 1st Battalion, 508th Parachute Infantry, and of Company C, 3rd Battalion, 82nd Airborne Division: four tanks had been moved secretly to Howard Air Force Base by C-5 in November 1989, and ten more were dropped by C-141 at Tocumen International Airport within hours of the opening of the fighting, the only combat airdrop of that type ever made. The ground forces also used the Humvee in quantity for the first time. The equipment of the Panamanian Defence Force was an old mixture of Soviet and Chinese patterns: AK-47 and AKM rifles, RPG-7 launchers, general purpose machine guns and small calibre anti-aircraft guns, together with M16 rifles and M2 machine guns supplied by the United States during the 1980s. The air force had only a few A-37 Dragonfly attack aircraft and twin-engined piston transports, the navy only patrol boats and river craft, one patrol boat being sunk by the SEALs on the first night. Set side by side, the gap was not in any single weapon but in air superiority, lift capacity and night-vision equipment taken as a whole.
tactics:
美軍的整套打法分五段。第一段是外交與法律鋪墊：12月15日巴拿馬國民大會通過決議，宣布與美國處於戰爭狀態；12月16日路障事件造成美軍軍人死亡；12月17日布希下令，12月18日參謀長聯席會議確定D日與H時為12月20日凌晨一時。計畫本身經歷多次改名，從「祈禱書」系列演到保衛運河的「巨蟒行動」、演練用的「紫色風暴行動」、整合後的「藍勺行動」，最後改稱「正義事業」以維持正當性；美方還刻意讓媒體以假想入侵的口徑報導計畫，配合軍事欺敵，1989年8月電視台已播出把入侵寫成劇本的專題。
第二段是制空與電子戰：EF-111A對巴拿馬雷達網實施干擾，AC-130砲艇與F-117A夜鷹隱形攻擊機在夜間打擊國防軍指揮部與機場；F-117A、AH-64阿帕奇與悍馬車都在這場戰爭中首次實戰。第三段是首夜的奇襲：12月20日凌晨零時四十六分前後，第508空降步兵團第1營C連與第59工兵連的坑道工兵夜襲阿馬多爾堡，控制這個護衛運河太平洋入口、美洲大橋與大片油庫的要塞；海豹突擊隊在運河區與阿馬多爾堤道一帶登陸，攻擊國防軍第三旅指揮部與各處兵營，代號「利落包裹」的行動摧毀諾列加的私人專機並擊沉一艘國防軍巡邏艇，付出四名突擊隊員陣亡、九人受傷的代價；空降兵在巴拿馬城郊與運河區多點傘降，切斷泛美公路與運河區的連接。
第四段是城市戰。第508團第1營攻入國防軍總司令部拉科馬丹西亞，雙方在樓房與街壘間逐屋爭奪，交火引起的大火吞噬了喬里略社區大部分街區；AH-64與AH-1W在低空用機炮掃射，掩護步兵推進；M551謝里登坦克在狹窄街道上提供火力。主要軍事行動到12月24日告一段落。
第五段是政治過渡與秩序恢復。「正義事業」在1990年1月31日結束，隨後由「促進自由行動」接替，負責解散國防軍、收繳散落武器、重建政府機構；1990年2月10日新政府廢除國防軍，改組為巴拿馬公共部隊。
tacticsEn: The American method falls into five stages. The first is diplomatic and legal preparation: on 15 December the Panamanian National Assembly passed a resolution declaring a state of war with the United States; on 16 December the roadblock incident produced an American military death; on 17 December Bush signed the order; and on 18 December the Joint Chiefs of Staff fixed the D day and the hour as 0100 on 20 December. The plan itself changed names repeatedly, from the series of exercise plans called the Book of Prayers to Operation Python for the defence of the canal, to Operation Purple Storm for the exercises, to the consolidated Operation Blue Spoon, and finally to Just Cause, in order to keep up its legitimacy. The Americans also fed the media a fictitious version of the plan, to work with the military deception: by August 1989 television had already carried a feature in which the invasion was written as a drama. The second stage is air superiority and electronic warfare: EF-111As jammed the Panamanian radar network, while AC-130 gunships and F-117A Nighthawk stealth attack aircraft struck command posts and airfields by night; the F-117A, the AH-64 Apache and the Humvee all saw combat for the first time in this war. The third stage is the assault of the opening night: at about 0046 hours on 20 December, Company C of the 1st Battalion, 508th Parachute Infantry, together with the tunnel engineers of the 59th Engineer Company, assaulted Fort Amador by night and seized the fortress that guards the Pacific entrance of the canal, the Americas Bridge and the great oil storage area; SEALs landed in the Canal Zone and around the Amador causeway and struck the headquarters of the third brigade and the barracks, the operation code-named Nifty Package destroying Noriega's private aircraft and sinking a Defence Force patrol boat at a cost of four assault men killed and nine wounded; and paratroopers dropped in strength on several axes on the outskirts of Panama City and in the Canal Zone, cutting the Pan-American Highway and the links into the zone. The fourth stage is the urban fight. The 1st Battalion of the 508th fought its way into the Defence Force general headquarters at La Comandancia, house by house and barricade by barricade, and the fires set off by the exchange of fire consumed most of the El Chorrillo district; the AH-64 and the AH-1W fired their rotary cannon along the streets to cover the infantry, and the M551 Sheridans gave fire support in the narrow roads. The main military operations wound down by 24 December. The fifth stage is the political transition and the restoration of order: Just Cause ended on 31 January 1990 and was followed by Promote Freedom, which was given the task of breaking up the Defence Force, collecting the weapons that had been scattered, and rebuilding the institutions of government; on 10 February 1990 the new government abolished the Defence Force and reorganised it as the Panamanian Public Force.
data:
可核對的數字集中在幾處。兵力方面，美軍史料記錄本次行動投入美軍人員兩萬七千六百八十四人、軍機三百餘架；南方司令部估計巴拿馬國防軍約一萬六千人。時間線清晰：12月15日巴拿馬宣戰，12月16日路障事件，12月17日下令，12月20日凌晨零時四十六分開火，主要軍事行動持續到12月24日，1990年1月3日諾列加投降，1990年1月31日「正義事業」結束，同年開始的「促進自由行動」一直運作到1994年9月。
損失方面，美軍官方記錄為二十三人陣亡、三百二十五人受傷，其中二名陣亡者與十九名受傷者經認定為友軍誤傷；南方司令部統計巴拿馬國防軍陣亡約三百一十四人。戰區內其他損失的數字，各方統計相差極大且互相矛盾，本檔案不採用任何單一數字。
裝備與地理的數字：M551謝里登有四輛在1989年11月先行運抵霍華德空軍基地，十輛在開戰後數小時空投托庫門；抓獲諾列加的懸賞為一百萬美元；巴拿馬運河全長約八十公里，運河區由阿馬多爾堡、克萊頓堡等堡壘構成；科倫港是大西洋端的樞紐，托庫門國際機場是巴拿馬城的主要空港。作戰部隊中女性軍人約六百人，主要擔任軍事警察、運輸與直升機飛行任務。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are concentrated in a few places. On strength, the American records give twenty-seven thousand six hundred and eighty-four personnel and more than three hundred aircraft committed to the operation, while Southern Command estimated the Panamanian Defence Force at about sixteen thousand men. The timeline is clear: Panama declares war on 15 December, the roadblock incident on 16 December, the order on 17 December, the opening of fire at 0046 hours on 20 December, the main military operations continuing to 24 December, Noriega's surrender on 3 January 1990, the end of Just Cause on 31 January 1990, and Promote Freedom, which began in the same year, running on until September 1994. On losses, the American official record gives twenty-three killed and three hundred and twenty-five wounded, of whom two dead and nineteen wounded were ruled to have been killed or hurt by friendly fire; Southern Command counted about three hundred and fourteen Panamanian military dead. The figures for other losses in the theatre differ enormously from source to source and contradict one another, and no single figure is adopted here. On equipment and geography: four of the M551 Sheridans were moved to Howard Air Force Base in November 1989 and ten more were dropped at Tocumen within hours of the opening of the fighting; the reward for the capture of Noriega was one million dollars; the Panama Canal is about eighty kilometres long; the Canal Zone was held by a ring of fortifications among them Fort Amador and Fort Clayton; Colón is the hub at the Atlantic end, and Tocumen International Airport is the main airport of Panama City. Of the deployed force about six hundred were women, serving chiefly as military police, drivers and helicopter pilots.
cause:
打起來有四層原因，層層相扣。第一層是《巴拿馬運河條約》的僵局：1977年9月7日卡特與托里霍斯簽署條約，運河區立即廢除，運河控制權最遲於1999年12月31日移交，條約要求運河繼續向美國船隻開放，而美方堅持巴拿馬必須先由國民大會批准並切實執行協議，諾列加則以拖延回應。
第二層是從盟友變成對手的過程。諾列加自1967年起充當中央情報局線人，在反桑地諾鬥爭中與美方合作並按年領取情報報酬；1986年里根政府要求他下台，赫什在《紐約時報》揭露毒品資金往來；1988年2月他被聯邦大陪審團起訴，3月眾議院通過要求他下台的決議，11月參議院削減援助；同年11月他在聯合國投票支持桑地諾陣線，關係公開破裂，1989年4月美方提出「不要毒品、不要民主」的交換條件並撤走南方司令部。
第三層是1989年5月的大選與一連串挫敗。反對派聯盟的計票顯示恩達拉以近三比一領先卡洛斯·杜克，諾列加隨即宣布選舉無效；10月第二次政變被國防軍挫敗；12月15日國民大會宣布與美國交戰，12月16日路障事件造成美軍軍人死亡。
第四層是雙方的時間計算。諾列加認為美國在越南之後不會再打地面戰，反對派分裂、軍隊效忠自己，哥斯大黎加、委內瑞拉、哥倫比亞與西班牙等國的斡旋可以拖住美方；布希則認定諾列加已無法合法執政，且在國內民意壓力下需要一次乾淨俐落的軍事結果。於是美方一面在邊境上以「無視路障」的挑釁性巡邏製造口實，一面把行動包裝成保衛民主與打擊毒品的正義之舉，最終在12月17日簽下命令。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause behind the fighting, each tied to the next. The first is the deadlock over the Panama Canal Treaty: on 7 September 1977 Carter and Torrijos signed the treaty, the Canal Zone was abolished at once, control of the canal was to pass to Panama no later than 31 December 1999, and the treaty required the canal to remain open to American shipping; Washington insisted that Panama should first ratify and faithfully execute the agreements through its National Assembly, and Noriega answered with delay. The second layer is the process by which an ally became an enemy. Noriega had served as a CIA asset since 1967, had worked with Washington against the Sandinistas and drawn his retainer year by year; in 1986 the Reagan administration demanded his resignation, and Seymour Hersh exposed the drug money in The New York Times; in February 1988 he was indicted by a federal grand jury, in March the House of Representatives passed a resolution calling for his resignation, and in November the Senate cut the aid; in that same November he voted in the United Nations with the Sandinistas, the break became public, and in April 1989 Washington offered the terms of no drugs and no democracy and withdrew its Southern Command. The third layer is the election of May 1989 and the run of setbacks around it. The opposition alliance's count showed Endara leading Carlos Duque by nearly three to one, and Noriega immediately declared the election void; a second coup was defeated by the Defence Force in October; the National Assembly declared war on the United States on 15 December, and the roadblock incident of 16 December produced an American military death. The fourth layer is the arithmetic of time on both sides. Noriega reckoned that after Vietnam the United States would not fight a ground war on the ground, that the opposition was divided, that the army was loyal to him, and that mediation by Costa Rica, Venezuela, Colombia and Spain would hold the Americans off; Bush judged that Noriega could no longer rule legitimately and that, under domestic pressure, the answer had to be a clean and decisive military result. The Americans therefore produced incidents on the frontier with provocative patrols that ignored the roadblocks, and dressed the action up as the defence of democracy and the war on drugs, and on 17 December the order was signed.
impact:
巴拿馬的國家形態在這場戰爭之後被重塑。1990年2月10日恩達拉政府廢除國防軍，1990年4月運河區正式撤銷、美軍在巴拿馬的設施移交新政府，1990年12月31日《運河條約》經國民大會批准生效，1994年憲法修正案更永久廢除國家常備軍，只保留公共部隊與警衛隊。1999年12月31日運河主權按條約移交巴拿馬，成為該國財政與國家認同的核心；配合科隆自由貿易區、美元化與後來的運河擴建，巴拿馬逐步成為中美洲的物流與金融中心。
國際層面同樣留下痕跡。12月22日美洲國家組織通過譴責決議並要求美軍撤軍，12月23日安理會要求撤軍的草案被美國、英國與法國否決，12月29日聯合國大會以七十五票贊成、二十票反對、四十票棄權通過譴責決議，歐洲議會與秘魯亦有譴責與召回大使之舉。學界主流看法是此舉違反《聯合國憲章》第二條與《美洲國家組織憲章》關於不干涉內政的條款；巴拿馬國民議會則在2007年一致通過把12月20日定為國家哀悼日的決議，雖被當時的總統否決，巴拿馬政府仍在2019年12月19日宣布次日為全國哀悼日並降半旗。
在美國方面，這場戰爭留下制度性的先例：法律顧問解釋，1878年的《地方保安隊法》只在美國境內有效，軍隊因此可以在海外執行聯邦逮捕令；五角大樓作戰計畫的模式、夜襲奪點的做法與「有限目標」的框定，兩年後直接被1991年海灣戰爭沿用，也是冷戰後單邊主義干預的早期形態。
諾列加本人於1990年被押往美國受審，1992年以販毒、詐騙與洗錢等八項罪名被判四十年監獄，後減為三十年，並被引渡回巴拿馬羈押，2017年5月29日在巴拿馬城病逝。1990年7月19日，六十家在巴拿馬經營的企業在紐約南區聯邦地院控告美政府以侵權方式行事，險種公司則以戰爭行為不在承保範圍內拒賠，美方其後以每戶六千五百美元的標準補助受影響的家庭重建。
impactEn: The shape of the Panamanian state was remade after this war. On 10 February 1990 the Endara government abolished the Defence Force; in April 1990 the Canal Zone was formally dissolved and the American installations in Panama were handed to the new government; on 31 December 1990 the Canal Treaty was approved by the National Assembly and took effect; and a 1994 amendment to the constitution abolished the national standing army for good, leaving only the Public Force and the National Guard. On 31 December 1999 sovereignty over the canal passed to Panama under the treaty, becoming the core of the country's finances and of its sense of itself; with the Colón free zone, dollarisation and the later expansion of the canal, Panama gradually became a logistics and financial centre of Central America. The international layer left its marks too. On 22 December the Organization of American States passed a resolution of condemnation and demanded the withdrawal of the American forces; on 23 December a Security Council draft calling for withdrawal was vetoed by the United States, Britain and France; on 29 December the General Assembly of the United Nations condemned the invasion by seventy-five votes to twenty with forty abstentions; the European Parliament and Peru likewise protested, Peru recalling its ambassador. The prevailing scholarly view is that the action violated Article 2 of the United Nations Charter and the provisions of the Charter of the Organization of American States on non-intervention; the Panamanian legislature voted unanimously in 2007 to designate 20 December a national day of mourning, which the president of the day vetoed, and the Panamanian government finally proclaimed the following 20 December a national day of mourning on 19 December 2019 and flew the flag at half mast. On the American side the war left an institutional precedent: legal advisers ruled that the Posse Comitatus Act of 1878 applies only within the United States, so that the military could act overseas to execute a federal arrest warrant; and the shape of the Pentagon's operational plan, the practice of seizing objectives by night assault and the framing of the campaign in terms of limited objectives were all taken over directly by the Gulf War two years later, forming an early shape of unilateral intervention after the Cold War. Noriega himself was taken to the United States for trial in 1990, convicted in 1992 on eight counts including drug trafficking, fraud and money laundering, sentenced to forty years and later reduced to thirty, and extradited back to Panama, where he died in Panama City on 29 May 2017. On 19 July 1990 sixty companies operating in Panama sued the United States government in the Southern District of New York, alleging that the invasion had been carried out in a negligent and reckless manner, with the insurers declining to pay on the ground that war was outside the scope of cover, and the American government afterwards paid the affected households six thousand five hundred dollars each towards rebuilding.
result:
軍事結果非常明確：巴拿馬國防軍在首夜失去指揮系統，主要抵抗在12月24日結束，部隊被解散，軍人解甲，武器被收繳，1990年2月10日國防軍在法律上廢除，改組為巴拿馬公共部隊。諾列加的個人結局則拖了兩週多：12月24日他躲入梵蒂岡駐巴拿馬城大使館求庇護，美軍在使館周邊晝夜播放音樂並進行全城搜捕，一百萬美元懸賞懸而未落；美方解釋播放音樂主要是防止竊聽談判內容，而非心理戰。1990年1月3日諾列加正式向美軍投降，被送上MC-130E「戰鬥爪」運機送往美國，此後受審、判刑、引渡回國，2017年病逝於巴拿馬城。
政治結果是恩達拉與阿里斯蒂德斯組成的政府上台，反對派聯盟在1990年5月的大選中獲勝，1994年又出現中美洲少數的和平政權輪替。戰術層面的教訓更值得記取：面對一個在首夜就被端掉指揮部、幾乎沒有制空權與海軍、幾乎沒有戰術航空兵與夜視器材的國家，抵抗只能退化成街壘裡的殘餘抵抗；美軍取勝的關鍵不在某一種單兵，而在空運形成的時間差、縱深奇襲的節奏、六管旋轉機炮提供的近距火力密度，以及一整套從外交文件到資訊作戰的準備。1999年12月31日，運河按條約交還巴拿馬，美軍在巴拿馬的駐軍隨之撤離，這場戰爭的軍事章節在那一刻才算真正收束。
resultEn: The military result was plain: the Panamanian Defence Force lost its command system on the first night, the main resistance ended on 24 December, the units were broken up, the men disarmed, the weapons collected, and on 10 February 1990 the Defence Force was abolished in law and reorganised as the Panamanian Public Force. The personal outcome of Noriega took more than two weeks longer: on 24 December he took refuge in the Vatican embassy in Panama City, the Americans played music day and night around the embassy and searched the whole city, and the one-million-dollar reward went unclaimed; the American side explained that the music was played chiefly to prevent eavesdropping on the negotiations rather than as a psychological technique. On 3 January 1990 Noriega surrendered formally to the American forces and was carried off to the United States aboard an MC-130E Combat Talon, to be tried, sentenced, extradited back to his own country, and to die there in 2017. The political result was the coming to power of the government of Endara and Aristides, with the opposition alliance winning the election of May 1990 and a peaceful transfer of power following in 1994, one of the few in Central America. The lesson of the campaign at the tactical level is more worth keeping. Against a state whose command system was torn out on the first night, which had almost no air superiority and no navy, almost no tactical aviation and no night-vision equipment, resistance could degenerate into nothing more than a remnant resistance behind barricades. What decided the American success was not any single arm, but the time differential created by airlift, the tempo of the deep assaults, the density of close fire support provided by six-barreled rotary guns, and an entire preparation running from diplomatic documents through the information war. On 31 December 1999 the canal was handed back to Panama under the treaty and the American troops withdrew with it, and only at that moment was the military chapter of this war truly closed.
